name: EventX
description_en:
EventX provides conference registration, ticketing, attendee communications and onsite check-in with badge printing, plus optional virtual, lead and marketing tools. The homepage also presents an AI event companion, an MCP server in beta and conference-website search claims. Those capabilities require their own availability and entitlement checks.

The important pricing distinction is between a small free event, Essentials, Enterprise and a one-off package. The homepage’s blanket zero-commission message conflicts with the pricing page’s five-percent Essentials platform fee. This profile follows the plan-specific conditions and does not promise free ticket processing or search visibility.
description_zh:
EventX 提供会议报名、售票、沟通、现场签到及徽章，并有线上、线索和营销工具。首页另介绍 AI 活动助手、测试版 MCP 和网站搜索效果，这些应分别核对可用性与权益。

价格需区分小型免费方案、Essentials、Enterprise 和单次包。首页笼统零佣金与价格页 Essentials 5% 平台费冲突，本文按具体套餐说明，不承诺支付免费或搜索可见性。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect registrations and scan QR codes for check-in and badge workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 收集报名并扫描二维码，支持签到和徽章流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Essentials lists a five-percent platform fee; Enterprise lists zero percent.
core_features.explanation_zh: Essentials 列 5% 平台费，Enterprise 列 0%。

en: Manage a conference registration, session choice and onsite badge workflow.
zh: 管理会议报名、场次选择与现场徽章流程。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm plan fee/capacity and hardware, then pilot one paid registration, session permission and badge.
steps.zh: 确认套餐费率/容量及硬件，再试验一条付费报名、场次权限和徽章。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Subscription or one-off package by attendees/users and feature scope, plus plan-dependent platform fees and add-ons.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free: thirty attendees/event and one user. Essentials displays $149/$99 with billing selectors, 300 attendees/event, 5,000 monthly email credits and 5% ticketing platform fee. Enterprise quoted with 0% platform fee. One-off $1,499 for one event/500 attendees/one user/three months. Currency, billing selection, processors and add-ons require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 每场 30 人、1 用户；Essentials 在账期选择旁显示 $149/$99、每场 300 人、每月 5,000 邮件额度和 5% 平台费；Enterprise 询价、平台费 0%。单次 $1,499，1 活动/500 人/1 用户/3 个月。币种、账期、支付商与附加项需确认。

sources.title: EventX | AI Conference Solutions | All-in-One Conference Management Software
sources.research_notes_en: Current conference platform combines registration, marketing and onsite; beta MCP and vendor GEO/attendance claims are not independently established.

sources.title: Pricing: Free & Paid Event Management Plans | EventX
sources.research_notes_en: Free 30 attendees/event, Essentials 300 and 5% platform fee, Enterprise 0% platform fee, one-off 500 attendee event; conflicts with global 0% homepage wording.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Verify the attendee path before relying on marketing tools
sections.title_zh: 先核对参与者路径，再依赖营销工具
sections.en: An illustrative conference flow collects registration, selects sessions, takes payment and sends confirmation before QR check-in. Validate session eligibility, a changed attendee and a refund path with the actual printer and devices. AI lead generation and onsite lead capture serve different tasks and should not be merged into a guaranteed attendee-acquisition claim. No scan speed, lead quality or message-open result was measured here.
sections.zh: 例如会议流程包括报名、选择场次、付款、确认及二维码签到。应结合真实打印机和设备核对场次资格、人员修改和退款。AI 寻找潜在线索与现场线索采集是不同需求，不能合并成保证获客。本文未测扫描速度、线索质量或消息打开结果。

sections.title_en: Use the pricing page’s scoped fee conditions
sections.title_zh: 按价格页的具体条件计费
sections.en: Free lists unlimited events, thirty attendees per event and one user; the placement of email-sending text does not establish a free email allowance. Essentials lists $149 and $99 with monthly/annual selectors, up to 300 attendees per event, one user, 5,000 monthly email credits and a 5% ticketing platform fee. Enterprise is quoted with unlimited users/attendees and 0% platform fee. Verify the selected billing period and currency; do not generalize the homepage’s 0% headline.
sections.zh: Free 列不限活动、每场 30 人、1 用户，邮件文字的位置不能证明免费发送额度。Essentials 在月付/年付选择旁列 $149 和 $99、每场最多 300 人、1 用户、每月 5,000 邮件额度及 5% 售票平台费。Enterprise 询价、不限用户/人数，平台费 0%。应确认账期与币种，不能泛化首页 0% 标题。

sections.title_en: Scope the one-off window and add-ons
sections.title_zh: 定义单次使用窗口及附加项
sections.en: The one-off package is $1,499 for one event, up to 500 attendees, one user and three months of access. Hardware rental, badge production, onsite support, WhatsApp, event web app and SMTP are listed as Enterprise-only add-on modules. Confirm which are included, separately priced or unavailable for the chosen package. A zero platform fee never proves no processor, device or delivery cost.
sections.zh: 单次包 $1,499，限 1 活动、最多 500 人、1 用户及 3 个月访问。硬件租赁、徽章制作、现场支持、WhatsApp、网页应用和 SMTP 列为 Enterprise 专属附加模块。应确认所选方案是包含、另费还是不提供。平台费为零也不证明支付、设备或交付成本为零。

sections.title_en: Treat AI and search claims as untested vendor statements
sections.title_zh: 把 AI 与搜索宣传作为未测厂商说法
sections.en: The homepage labels the MCP server beta. Its GEO score and AI-discovery claims do not establish rankings, crawler access or generated-answer inclusion for your event site. Cross-border accessibility, translations and private-cloud options likewise need deployment-specific confirmation. EventX is a candidate for connected conference operations, while a minimal RSVP may use the bounded Free offer. No security certification, AI behavior, self-hosted license, recovery or geographic access was independently verified.
sections.zh: 首页把 MCP 标为测试版，GEO 分数及 AI 发现宣传不能证明活动网站的排名、爬虫访问或生成式答案引用。跨境访问、翻译及私有云也需按部署核对。关联会议运营可以考虑 EventX，简易 RSVP 可核查受限 Free 方案。本次未独立核实安全认证、AI 行为、自托管许可、恢复或地区访问。

research_gaps: No registration, payment/refund, printer, WhatsApp, AI assistant, MCP, geographic access or SEO/GEO outcome was tested.
Homepage/pricing commission conflict, billing/currency, email entitlement, add-ons, contract data controls, license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
